FREERTOS_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install freertos. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

FREERTOS_VERSION.description: Specific version of freertos to install.

FREERTOS_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading freertos binary or archive artifacts.

FREERTOS_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying freertos available remote releases.

FREERTOS_PORT.description: Target FreeRTOS port/BSP identifier (mps2_an385, riscv_virt, qemu_cortex_a53, posix_gcc, win32_sim).

FREERTOS_HEAP_IMPL.description: FreeRTOS dynamic memory allocator scheme (heap_1, heap_2, heap_3, heap_4, heap_5, static_only).

FREERTOS_TICK_RATE_HZ.description: FreeRTOS scheduler tick interrupt frequency in Hz (configTICK_RATE_HZ).

FREERTOS_TOTAL_HEAP_BYTES.description: FreeRTOS heap pool capacity in bytes (configTOTAL_HEAP_SIZE).

FREERTOS_MAX_PRIORITIES.description: Maximum number of preemptive FreeRTOS task priorities (configMAX_PRIORITIES).

FREERTOS_MINIMAL_STACK_WORDS.description: Minimal per-task stack depth in machine words (configMINIMAL_STACK_SIZE).

FREERTOS_USE_PREEMPTION.description: Enable preemptive scheduling (1) or cooperative scheduling (0).

FREERTOS_NUMBER_OF_CORES.description: SMP core count configured via configNUMBER_OF_CORES.

FREERTOS_COMPILER.description: Compiler backend selector (default, gcc, clang, tcc, edgcpp, msvc, custom-cc).

FREERTOS_KERNEL_PATH.description: Active FreeRTOS-Kernel source directory exported by env.{sh,cmd}.

FREERTOS_FETCH_FULL_SOURCE.description: When set to 1, downloads and extracts the upstream FreeRTOS-Kernel release archive.
